# MUST Patent Law Firm (머스트 특허법률사무소)

> A Seoul-based intellectual property law firm representing foreign applicants and associates filing patents, trademarks, and designs in South Korea. Working languages: English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese.

## Services
- Patent prosecution in Korea, including PCT national phase entry (31-month deadline from priority date)
- Trademark registration in Korea, including Madrid Protocol designation
- Industrial design registration, including Hague Agreement designation
- Freedom-to-operate (FTO) analysis, IP disputes and invalidation trials
- IP valuation and technology transfer; particular strength in biotech, pharmaceutical, and healthcare
